statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to characterize the arrhythmia burden and assess for potential embolic risk factors
The service billed is CPT 93226 for 48-hour Holter monitoring
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and Z86.73
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the procedure is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
